section_summary.extract_value: This section, 'Part 2: the genetic modeling', details the genetic modeling approach using a classical twin design and structural equation modeling with the OpenMx package. The variables of interest for this analysis are artistic creative achievement (MAX_ART), scientific creative achievement (MAX_SCI), openness to experience (BFI_O), and intelligence (WMT). The modeling included univariate genetic analyses for each variable and two trivariate ACE Cholesky decompositions, one for each creative domain, with WMT, BFI_O, and MAX_ART/MAX_SCI.
